children: The Board of UIL Limited (the "Company") announces that on 19 November 2026 the Company sold in the market 20,000 2028 ZDP Shares issued by its subsidiary, UIL Finance Limited, at a price of 133.80p per 2028 ZDP Share.
Following this sale, UIL Limited has a holding of 2,856,461 2028 ZDP Shares and the total number of 2028 ZDP Shares in issue remains unchanged at 30,000,000.
